## 4. Attractive-invalid-ranking, justification and accountability

The exact frozen C1 faulty output was applied to the actual valid partial reader
result and its commitment verified. The independently implemented source-to-cell
check rejects the unsupported low exclusion at derivation/epistemic_invalid,
target mapped/compatibility/1, with no successful ranking fields. Restoration
recovers the exact valid unknown/no-score twin in both alternatives.

Deliberately bypassing that upstream check for diagnostic demonstration lets the
otherwise complete dishonest matrix pass unchanged arithmetic admission and
produce T1=1 versus T2=2. That attractive result is retained as **diagnostic-only**,
not an accepted useful recommendation. It demonstrates why complete BRC structural
admission alone cannot establish source justification. The approved path retains
unknown or rejects the faulty mapping before comparison.

C0 adds the separately identified complete synthetic exclusion basis. It actually
produces T1 worst survivors 1, T2 worst survivors 2, and T1 preferred within the
explicit supplied candidate set. This is justification under a supplied premise,
not empirical confirmation. Authority/citations do not turn that premise into a
validated forecast. Exact source, scope, declared exhaustiveness, contrary support,
exclusion basis and mapping traces are retained for the triplet.

Both alternatives preserve source accountability. Neither silently converts an
omitted outcome into impossible, resolves conflict by citation count/authority,
or replaces the declared decoder. Other-outcome partial coverage remains unknown;
the complete other twin ranks. C7 retains an explicit unexplained empty survivor
set with no useful discriminator. C9 preserves plural tied best with no winner.
Zero/one viable H cases have no scores or best recommendation.

Authority, citation count, source-ID and time changes cannot choose an envelope

Application and Claim receive identical source packets, scope, authorities and

Claim reads subject-bearing entries. Their relation loops are separate. Both
share public lower reconstruction, common admission/decoder rules, provenance/
serialization constructors, source-check policy and the BRC consumer. Their
agreement establishes parity under those shared checks; it is not independent
verification of the shared code or the truth of the supplied rules.

The UUTs do not read the oracle, package case names, expected labels or filenames.
Only the independent harness extracts cases and compares expected objects. Actual
cell results and traces agree between alternatives apart from their intentional
representation/request wrapper. No difference in required information, validation
strength or integrity boundary was demonstrated. Wrapper nesting is not credited
as a new backend capability or predictive evidence.

## 6. Resource enforcement and actual maxima

The runtime uses independent request admission and bounded output construction.
The retention transport is bounded by its manifest byte length/hash; each selected
canonical object receives its own size/hash, shallow/cardinality/depth, wire and
per-reference resolution accounting before owning reconstruction. The decoded
tree is fully charged. No compression or external digest lookup hides structure.

Output construction reserves each bounded fragment's exact added bytes and wire/
resolution charge before attaching it. Replacements adjust exact prior charges;
list appends reserve their comma/element costs before mutation. Temporary local
fragments are bounded by the admitted 2×2×3 corpus and literal schema limits, not
unbounded material built before checking. Final canonical serialization performs
a second token-wise reservation; result admission precedes authoritative reread.

| Actual complete boundary | Maximum charged nodes | Maximum bytes | Approved node limit |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Input | 6639 | 89968 | 12000 |
| Result | 9105 | 111394 | 13453 |

Two independent recursive/iterative canonical-tree counters agree, including
complete Statement resolution charges per typed reference occurrence. No validator
copy is recounted as wire data. Actual per-object depth, Statements, references
and complete resource counts are retained. These maxima include both alternatives
and the complete trace-heavy handoff, not only the primary role. Existing byte,
depth/cardinality/reference limits and the 16,384 safety ceiling are unchanged.

Complete valid domain inputs/results tested under a smaller trusted test budget
refuse at the intended boundary. Input and retained-result preflight refusals
perform zero owning calls. Construction refusals show exactly the three input
owner calls and no result-owning reread; the counter stays within the configured
node/byte budget before the rejected append. Partial success is discarded.
Nine fixed templates stay below the 1,024-byte reserve and cannot recursively
overflow; refused results contain no success payload. At/plus-one 12,000/12,001
and 13,453/13,454 tests exercise counting primitives, explicitly not padded valid
domain results. No naturally over-limit member is invented for this finite corpus.

## 9. Bounded conclusion and remaining questions

Application composition supplies the useful evidence-qualified answer and the
same safe refusal/ranking behavior as the experimental Claim representation for
this case. Claim is a possible packaging choice, but no additional necessary
model fact, shared lifecycle requirement or integrity boundary beyond existing
public composition was evidenced. The experiment neither proves all future
backend placement unnecessary nor chooses a future architecture.

Exclusion justification is explicit entailment from the nominated synthetic
complete-envelope premise and applicable decoder, not empirical validation.
Accountability identifies that premise, scope, origin and contrary support.
Algorithmic usefulness is demonstrated by the justified ranking and rejection
of the attractive unsupported mapping. Predictive validity remains unestablished;
an authority/citation does not prove it. No causal truth or real fault is found.

Objective 3 gains inspection of supplied explanations/consequences, not actual
diagnosis. Objective 4 gains defensible worst-case choice only within a fully
admitted explicit candidate set, not globally best or safely executable testing.
Objective 7 preserves observation/evaluation at level 1, declaration at 2,
hypotheses assumed at 3, methods/conditional premises assumed at 4, calculation
at 5, bounded inference at 6 and unknown at 7. Real predictive evidence and
broader hypothesis completeness remain open. Objective 5 change impact is not
established by citation dependence; objective 6 planning is not established by
preferring a measurement. No successor, milestone, ADR or implementation follows.

No unresolved defect or additional semantic conflict remains in the approved
corpus. Single remaining gate: owner acceptance of this bounded comparative proof.
